methodology: Outlet-level ratings are third-party assessments, not judgments about each article, accuracy or its author. Ratings primarily assess US political framing and may translate poorly to Indian or geopolitical contexts. Academic and official material is not automatically neutral. Unknown means unrated, not centrist.

reuters_india.scope: Reuters online written reporting; US political scale, not India-specific assessment

ap_world.scope: AP US political online reporting; not automatically global-desk content

bbc_world.scope: BBC written online reporting; not TV or radio

bbc_asia.scope: BBC written online reporting; extrapolated to Asia desk

fox_world.scope: Fox News Digital written web content; not broadcast

ft_world.scope: Financial Times online journalism; excludes a judgement of individual articles

wsj_world.scope: WSJ news section only; opinion section rated separately
